obligations.text: Minimum create/import/preview/author/interactive-run/clean-replay/save/reopen/export workflow and bounded language support
Schema/type/null/Unicode/timestamp/row-order contract, conversion and malformed-input behavior; originals retained
Separate cell order, execution order, kernel state and saved output provenance; guarantees and limits of clean replay
Defined invalidation/current/stale/failed/unverified states after code, dataset or environment changes, restart and interrupted execution
Bounded/streaming large-data path, preview limits, caching/ordering/concurrency/cancel, and interrupted-save recovery without unsupported performance claims
Untrusted code execution permissions/isolation/resource boundary and usable error/status/dependency/provenance presentation
Candidate-discovered >=2 independently useful implementation precedents with source/pins and concrete plan implications
Candidate-discovered real issue/failure -> associated fix -> regression test chain with applicability and causal limits
At least one useful opportunity and one plausible alternative, with coherent design/critical dependencies and optional adoption distinguished from requirements
Consequential replay/data/invalidation witnesses discriminate behavior; executed/proposed labels and synthetic/full-runtime scope honest
Standalone current final preserves supported findings/conditions, fixes actual errors, cites exact evidence and exposes unresolved leads

consequential_current_claims: Evaluator additionally assesses all consequential claims introduced in the designated final, not only these headings.
optional_choice_rule: A useful opportunity/alternative is required research coverage; adopting it is optional.
predeclared_matched_screen: Inspect source/applicability correctness of design-critical claims, actual independent precedents/issue chain, and support for each claimed executed witness in both arms; preserve remainder UNASSESSED on decisive screen.
